basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school senior from Edmonton, Canada, who is passionate about education and personal growth. I’m currently in the process of applying to several universities, with a strong interest in business and computer science. In my free time, I enjoy playing FIFA, exploring vegan recipes, and learning about different cultures and religions. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after school and on weekends. I'm single and focused on my academic and personal goals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a high school student, my knowledge is primarily based on my academic coursework and personal interests. I'm keen on learning about college application processes, which has led me to frequently visit subreddits like ApplyingToCollege. I've also been exploring veganism through subreddits like yegvegan and enjoy participating in discussions about video gaming on fut.
